issue: BuildRuleset silently drops IPv6 server IPs (the `!ip.Contains(':')` filter) while the `inet` table with `policy drop` blocks ALL IPv6 egress; ReadServerIps (line 226) accepts literal IPv6 addresses via IPAddress.TryParse — an IPv6-only VPN server + sing-box crash = kill-switch blocks the reconnect, bricking the host until manual `sudo nft delete table inet vpnrouter_ks`
fix: Emit an `ip6 daddr { <v6 servers> } accept` rule alongside the v4 one: split serverIps into v4/v6, add `add rule inet vpnrouter_ks output ip6 daddr { ... } accept` when v6 is non-empty. Add a BuildRuleset test with a literal IPv6 server (e.g. "2001:db8::1") asserting the ip6 accept line is present.

issue: BuildRules emits `pass out quick inet from any to {ip}` for every server IP, but pf `inet` is IPv4-only; a literal IPv6 server address (accepted by ReadServerIps at line 359 via IPAddress.TryParse) produces invalid pf syntax — pfctl's atomic ruleset load fails entirely, so the kill-switch silently never engages (fail-open, zero leak protection)
fix: Split serverIps by family: emit `pass out quick inet from any to {v4}` for IPv4 and `pass out quick inet6 from any to {v6}` for IPv6. Add a BuildRules test with a literal IPv6 server asserting the `inet6` pass line is present and no `inet` line wraps an IPv6 address.
